article.story: Kansas State (4-3) at Colorado (2-5), Oct. 31 at 2 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Kansas State by 2.5. Against the spread: Kansas State 3-4, Colorado 2-5. How to watch: TNT Key stats Kansas State Offense Overall: 438.0 yards per game (32nd in FBS) Passing: 220.4 yards per game (79th) Rushing: 217.6 yards per game (14th) Scoring: 32.9 points per game (42nd) Kansas State Defense Overall: 305.3 yards per game (25th in FBS) Passing: 147.1 yards per game (5th) Rushing: 158.1 yards per game (93rd) Scoring: 21.1 points per game (46th) Colorado Offense Overall: 394.9 yards per game (63rd in FBS) Passing: 266.6 yards per game (34th) Rushing: 128.3 yards per game (111th) Scoring: 20.1 points per game (120th) Colorado Defense Overall: 391.7 yards per game (105th in FBS) Passing: 252.3 yards per game (118th) Rushing: 139.4 yards per game (67th) Scoring: 30.1 points per game (112th) Colorado ranks 94th in third down percentage, converting 36.5% of the time. Kansas State ranks 36th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 34.0%. Colorado ranks 135th in the FBS with a -9 turnover margin. Colorado is 135th in the FBS averaging 84.3 penalty yards per game, compared to Kansas State's 7th-ranked 37.3 per-game average. Colorado is 123rd in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75.0% of trips. Kansas State's red zone defense ranks 18th at 73.9%. Colorado is 104th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:52, compared to Kansas State's 17th-ranked average of 32:38. Team leaders Kansas State Passing: Avery Johnson, 1,301 yards, 10 TDs, 3 INTs, 63.1 completion percentage Rushing: Johnson, 462 yards on 51 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Jaron Tibbs, 325 yards on 34 catches, 4 TDs Colorado Passing: Isaac Wilson, 979 yards, 6 TDs, 7 INTs, 60.2 completion percentage Rushing: Jaquail Smith, 298 yards on 64 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Joseph Williams, 643 yards on 46 catches, 5 TDs Last game Kansas State was defeated by Arizona State 28-17 on Oct. 24. Jacob Knuth passed for 194 yards on 26-of-41 attempts (63.4%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball nine times for 19 yards and one rushing touchdown. Rodney Fields Jr. carried the ball 10 times for 36 yards. Derrick Salley Jr. had six receptions for 63 yards. Colorado fell 57-24 to Oklahoma State on Oct. 24. Wilson led Colorado with 280 yards on 19-of-27 passing (70.4%) for two touchdowns and two interceptions. He also carried the ball 14 times for 16 yards and one rushing touchdown. Smith carried the ball 13 times for 39 yards, adding one reception for four yards and one touchdown. Williams put up 135 yards on nine catches. Next game Kansas State hosts No. 24 Oklahoma State on Nov. 7. Colorado plays at Arizona State on Nov. 7.
